message.content:
In the key of **A**, the blues scale follows the classic “1 – b3 – 4 – b5 – 5 – b7” pattern.  
So the notes are:

| Scale degree | Note |
|--------------|------|
| 1 (root)     | **A** |
| b3 (minor 3rd) | **C** |
| 4 (perfect 4th) | **D** |
| b5 (flat 5th, the “blue” note) | **D♯** (or E♭) |
| 5 (perfect 5th) | **E** |
| b7 (minor 7th) | **G** |
| (octave)     | **A** |

Thus the A blues scale is: **A – C – D – D♯ – E – G – A**.
